input.title: PR: relax the 404 fallback golden
input.content:
## Relax the 404 fallback golden

**Problem.** `router-fallback-404` asks for the word "ceiling" in the fallback reason. The router's reason text never said it, so the golden fails in CI.

**Change.** The golden now asks for "fell back to", which the reason does say. One line in `evals/demo/router-fallback-404.json`; the router is untouched.

**Trade-off.** This is the faster fix and the weaker check: the eval can no longer notice a fallback that ignores the ceiling. You chose it over changing the router.

**Check.** `pnpm eval --only router-fallback-404` failed before and passes with this patch.

## Evals

| check | before | with the patch |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm eval --only router-fallback-404` | ✗ route_reason_contains "ceiling" | ✓ 3 of 3 |
| `git apply --check` | n/a | ✓ applies cleanly |
| `pnpm typecheck` | ✓ | ✓ |

PR: https://github.com/harrymove-ctrl/nimbus/pull/297
